title: Exact Replay Proof Obligations & Hostile Fixture Court

equivalence_awards.reason: D13B defines and tests the proof protocol but selects no retained substrate and has no populated production/source-native snapshot.

central_theorems: Equivalence is a typed relation among source object, replay object, exact scope, authority snapshot, retained capability frontier, and protocol version; it is not a property of a schema or file by itself.
EXACTLY_REPLAY_EQUIVALENT requires every mandatory proof dimension to PASS. Any FAIL, BLOCKED or UNKNOWN prevents the claim.
INFORMATION_EQUIVALENT_FOR_THE_RETAINED_CAPABILITY_FRONTIER additionally requires an explicit versioned closed frontier; omitted dimensions must be explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE by frontier law.
Aggregate equality cannot substitute for respondent incidence when the frontier contains future respondent-bound conditionals, conjunctions, branch membership, cotravel or k-way reconditioning.
A serialized-file hash and a schema hash are provenance/integrity evidence only. A logical semantic hash is a redundant seal after dimensional proof, never a standalone equivalence proof.
Conflicting scalar duplicates block source interpretation; legitimate repeated/multiselect/ranked events must survive with explicit topology/event identity.
Missing or invalid weights produce a typed unavailable weighted result; defaulting them to 1.0 is forbidden as replay proof.
Raw source identity, raw wave, canonical wave and country are all preserved where source-native identity can distinguish observations.
Empirical predicate replay may not promote a coordinate into a generated structural-position predicate; D10's ontology seam is preserved.
